config.title: Raw config
config.warning: Raw config: staff-written HTML, operator-level permission — Every value is public (GET /site returns it to everyone), so never put a secret here; secrets go on the Settings page. The announcement and footer are staff-written HTML, cleaned before they show; tracking code accepts only the operator's own pattern. Only those with "Edit raw config" permission.
config.listNote: The list comes from GET /site; the admin page reads it with cache: no-cache.
config.previewLabel: Preview in an isolated frame (runs no code)
config.previewNote: Script tags, on… event attributes, iframes and javascript: links do not run in the preview; the live page cleans the value when it shows.
config.urlNote: A link key accepts only http or https.
config.trackingNote: Only the operator's own tracking snippet may be used; the server does not check this text yet.
config.deleteBody: Every page stops using this value at once.

errors.keyPattern: The key needs 1–30 characters, no control characters.
errors.url: A link key accepts only http or https.

nav.title: Navigation bar
nav.treeNote: Parents first, children indented under them. An entry with children cannot be deleted; delete the children first (409).
nav.infoTitle: How the navigation bar reads its data
nav.info: An entry whose parent is missing, or that sits in a loop, shows at the top level; the server does not walk the tree on save, so old data can still be out of line. Changes show at once on this machine; other machines update within a few seconds.
nav.regexBroken: Broken regex: {message}. The entry still shows but is never marked active.
nav.deleteBody: The entry leaves the navigation bar at once.
nav.hasChildren: An entry with children cannot be deleted; delete the children first.

dialog.pathHint: A path on the site or an http(s) URL.
dialog.parentHint: An entry cannot sit under itself or its descendants.

errors.label: The label is 1–20 characters.
errors.path: Use a path on the site (starting with /) or an http(s) URL.
errors.regexTooLong: The regex is too long (up to 500 characters).

issues.parent_cycle: An entry cannot sit under itself or its descendants.
issues.parent_unknown: The parent entry does not exist.
issues.invalid_path: Use a path on the site or an http(s) URL.
